newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps little changed, CFDs ease, mogas flat.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps little changed, CFDs ease, mogas flat.

text.p: European oil swaps were little changed on Wednesday despite gains on futures.
Brent showed some signs of weakness on CFDs but oil products were steady or a touch higher.

Brent crude CFDs were unchanged for the balance of this week at 38 cents under June but next week's dates slipped three cents to 41 cents under. The following two weeks also slipped a few cents but activity was thin.

Gasoline swaps stayed unchanged, trading at $197.25 for May with physical trading at $197 for any May and $193.25 for April. June swaps talked some $3.50 a tonne below May, with July a further $3.50 below June.
Heavy fuel eased $1 a tonne to talk around $83 for May barges after peaking at $85.50 on Tuesday. June was 50 cents higher but dealers said the thin physical market had dampened trade.
Low sulphur was valued around $89 for May.

Jet premiums were flat with May bid at $24.50 a tonne above the IPE after trading at that level last Thursday. The third and fourth quarters were little changed at $27.50 and $31.50 above the screen respectively.
